title: Heart of Palm: Nutrition and Uses on Hike Found Vegetable
reason: Describes the properties and nutritional value of heart of palm.

tasks.task: Explain the nutritional benefits of heart of palm.

subtasks.text: Observe that heart of palm is a vegetable which goes bad very quickly.
Note that to eat heart of palm, many people boil it.

tasks.task: Detail the amino acid content of heart of palm.

subtasks.text: Highlight that heart of palm contains 17 different amino acids including the 9 essential amino acids your body cannot produce on its own.
Mention that it's low in fat and sugar but high in fiber.

tasks.task: Describe other nutritional benefits of heart of palm.

subtasks.text: Point out that the most common mineral found in heart of palm is potassium.
Note that heart of palm is also an excellent source of protein, which is very uncommon in vegetables.
